headline: Controversy at DU: DUCSU archive replaces Bangabandhu's photo with Jinnah's
summary: Students have torn down photos of Muhammad Ali Jinnah up after they were placed in the DUCSU archive, replacing them with an image of Ghulam Azam being humiliated.
details: A controversy has erupted at Dhaka University over the placement of photos of Muhammad Ali Jinnah in the DUCSU archive, and the removal of photos of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
Following the dispute, students tore down three photos of Jinnah from the archive's walls.
In place of the torn photos, students then displayed an image showing the late Jamaat-e-Islami chief Ghulam Azam being beaten with shoes.
The Dhaka University administration has cited a violation of university law regarding these changes to the archive.
DUCSU representatives have faced backlash for the initial decision to remove Bangabandhu's image and install Jinnah's.
caption:
Bangabandhu's photo removed, Jinnah's installed—and then torn down by students. Tension rises at Dhaka University.

A controversy has erupted at Dhaka University over the placement of photos of Muhammad Ali Jinnah in the DUCSU archive, and the removal of photos of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

Following the dispute, students tore down three photos of Jinnah from the archive's walls.

In place of the torn photos, students then displayed an image showing the late Jamaat-e-Islami chief Ghulam Azam being beaten with shoes.

The Dhaka University administration has cited a violation of university law regarding these changes to the archive.

DUCSU representatives have faced backlash for the initial decision to remove Bangabandhu's image and install Jinnah's.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Dozens injured as [[Islami Bank protest turns violent]] in Dhaka
headline: Dozens injured as Islami Bank protest turns violent in Dhaka
summary: Clashes erupted between sacked employees demanding reinstatement and a customer forum outside the bank's head office in Motijheel.
details: Dozens of people were injured yesterday in a violent clash between members of a customer forum and former employees of Islami Bank Bangladesh PLC outside the bank’s head office in Dhaka.
The two groups had gathered outside Islami Bank Tower in Motijheel to hold separate programs, which eventually escalated into a scuffle and then a full-scale clash.
The sacked employees, allegedly recruited during the S Alam Group's tenure starting in 2017, were terminated during the interim government's term and are now demanding their jobs back.
Members of the —’Sachetan Grahak Forum’— have been opposing these reinstatement demands.
Both sides have traded accusations of violence. A representative of the sacked employees claimed 25 of their members were injured and admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
Conversely, the president of the Sachetan Grahak Forum alleged that around 30 of its members were injured, including five seriously, claiming they were attacked during a peaceful demonstration.
caption:
Dozens injured in Dhaka as a bank protest turns into a violent clash.

Dozens of people were injured yesterday in a violent clash between members of a customer forum and former employees of Islami Bank Bangladesh PLC outside the bank’s head office in Dhaka.

The two groups had gathered outside Islami Bank Tower in Motijheel to hold separate programs, which eventually escalated into a scuffle and then a full-scale clash.

The sacked employees, allegedly recruited during the S Alam Group's tenure starting in 2017, were terminated during the interim government's term and are now demanding their jobs back.

Members of the —’Sachetan Grahak Forum’— have been opposing these reinstatement demands.

Both sides have traded accusations of violence. A representative of the sacked employees claimed 25 of their members were injured and admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.

Conversely, the president of the Sachetan Grahak Forum alleged that around 30 of its members were injured, including five seriously, claiming they were attacked during a peaceful demonstration.
